routing_warnings.description: The client proposes ongoing Facebook ad management through administrator access rather than recovery of the original profile restriction.
The proposal to set up another account belongs to the alternative-account Requirement; the ticket closure also provides context for the original recovery failure.
The client accepts setting up the alternative account rather than modifying the original-account recovery Requirement.
The request for the freelancer to manage Facebook ads is primarily about ongoing campaign management; only the condition about avoiding the sister affects the target setup Requirement.
The alternate email, initial meeting, and two-factor authentication details concern account setup and access rather than completed campaign management.
